title.zh: 【多个 Web3 项目网站遭到 DNS 劫持攻击】
title.en: Websites of several Web3 projects hit by DNS hijacking attack

current_state.zh:
Blockaid 在 X 上发推称，检测到包括 Flap、Stonk 等在内的多个 Web3 项目网站遭到 DNS 劫持攻击，用户访问时会被重定向到黑客设置的、包含恶意软件的页面。

通过被劫持的域名访问这些项目前端的用户，可能被导向攻击者控制的页面而非真实网站，从而面临恶意软件风险，而无法与原本的应用进行交互。

Blockaid 描述的这起事件影响的是项目网站的 DNS 解析环节，而非链上合约；该推文未说明受影响项目的具体数量或受影响用户规模。
current_state.en:
Blockaid said in a post on X that it detected DNS hijacking attacks on the websites of several Web3 projects, including Flap and Stonk, so that visitors are redirected to hacker-controlled pages containing malware.

Anyone who reached these project front-ends through the hijacked domains could be routed to attacker infrastructure rather than the genuine site, exposing visitors to malware rather than interacting with the intended application.

The compromise described by Blockaid affects the DNS resolution of the projects' websites rather than their on-chain contracts, and Blockaid did not state in the post how many projects or how many users were affected.

updates.background_zh: DNS 劫持是指攻击者通过篡改 DNS 记录、路由器或 DNS 连接等方式，操纵域名解析结果，从而把用户重定向到恶意网站的一类攻击。Blockaid 是一家 Web3 安全平台，通过扫描网站和 dApp 在威胁触达用户前进行识别，其检测能力被用于钱包和交易所的安全防护功能中。
updates.background_en: DNS hijacking is an attack in which an attacker manipulates how domain-name queries are resolved — for example by tampering with DNS records, routers or DNS connections — so that users are redirected to malicious websites. Blockaid is a Web3 security platform that scans websites and dApps for threats before they reach users, and its detection feeds security features used by wallets and exchanges.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次事件的传导渠道是前端与用户信任，而非协议流动性：dApp 域名的 DNS 层被劫持，可能把访问者推向钓鱼或盗取资产的页面，因此提供域名与 dApp 网址筛查的钱包和安全工具是受影响最直接的环节。
updates.market_impact_en: The channel here is front-end and user-facing trust rather than protocol liquidity: DNS-level compromises of dApp domains can push visitors toward phishing or drainer pages, so wallets and security tools that screen domains and dApp URLs are the segment most directly exposed.
